subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept a custom `bailian` provider-id inference path for Qwen thinking compat, or should Bailian reasoning remain only in the Qwen provider/plugin support boundary?
rationale: The source gap is real, but enabling provider-id-specific inference changes upgrade behavior for existing custom configs and overlaps with broader Qwen/Coding Plan support work.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference After Cleanup
options.body: Allow the generic configured-model paths to infer reasoning for Bailian Qwen compat once the vLLM hook is removed, tests cover the exact path, and contributor proof shows the no-explicit-reasoning behavior.

options.title: Keep Bailian In Qwen-Owned Support
options.body: Reject this PR's custom-provider inference and require users to use the official Qwen provider or a future Qwen-owned compatibility path.

options.title: Consolidate The Coding Plan Work
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for one provider-owned change that covers bundled catalog metadata, custom config, docs, and live vendor proof together.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow the generic configured-model paths to infer reasoning for Bailian Qwen compat once the vLLM hook is removed, tests cover the exact path, and contributor proof shows the no-explicit-reasoning behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history and related issue discussion make steipete the best available routing owner for the Qwen/Bailian support-boundary choice.
